subject: Post-call recap: StratoHealth renewal, usage profile & Private deployment pilot
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marta Garcia <marta.garcia@stratohealth.com>, Mark Kemp <mark.kemp@stratohealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 19:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: StratoHealth renewal, usage profile & Private deployment pilot

Hi Marta / Mark —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call so we have alignment and clear next steps.

What we heard (pain points / constraints):
- Increased latency variability on peak billing reconciliation workloads (up to ~600ms p95 today).
- Compliance requirement: HIPAA audit incoming in Q4; strong preference for Private (VPC/on-prem) option to limit egress and accelerate evidence gathering.
- Budget timing: procurement cycle closes mid-September; any expansion needs a clear cost estimate and pilot plan by early September.

Goals you stated:
- Stabilize p95 latency to <300ms for reconciliation pipelines while maintaining current throughput.
- Run 2-week Private pilot on representative workload (5–10M tokens/day) before committing to Dedicated or Private contract.
- Keep incremental cost increase below 25% YoY for the first year of the pilot/expansion.

Recommended path (our suggestion):
1) Short pilot: Private deployment (VPC) with a small dedicated GPU pool to validate latency and KV/cache behavior on your batch reconciliation workload.
2) Usage/dev review: We’ll run a focused evaluation harness using your sample prompts and sequence lengths (you shared a 3–5k token median and occasional 25k spikes).
3) Price/contract: Provide pilot estimate + MAP (mutual action plan) draft for procurement to review — aim to have this to you by Fri 8/6.

Deliverables we committed to on the call:
- Q2 usage report and token-level cost breakdown (attached: usage_report_q2.pdf).
- Draft MAP with milestones and success criteria (attached: MAP_Draft_StratoHealth.xlsx).
- A scoped Private deployment estimate for a 2-week pilot (will attach private_deploy_estimate.pdf when ready).

Proposed owners & timeline:
- Redwood (Tessa): finalize pilot estimate + send by 2027-08-06.
- StratoHealth (Marta/Mark): confirm dataset access approach and compliance contact for SOC/HIPAA evidence by 2027-08-09.
- Redwood (Naomi): prepare runbook for the Private pilot and help with customer-side checklist.

Immediate asks from you:
1) Confirm whether procurement wants a separate line-item pilot invoice or to roll pilot into the annual commit.
2) Share the sample reconciliation dataset (or pointer) and the compliance contact email for the HIPAA questions.

If that looks right I’ll follow up with the formal MAP and pilot estimate Friday. Thanks again — excited to partner here.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

E: tessa.morgan@redwood.com

Thanks, Tessa — this is exactly the sort of clarity we needed. A few notes: 

- Confirming priority: HIPAA audit (internal compliance) is the gating item. Without Private or VPC controls we won’t sign an expanded commitment.
- Procurement preference: they typically want a short, fixed-cost pilot rather than a credit-based roll-in. I’ll confirm exact PO process by 8/09.
- Dataset: I can share a redacted sample by end of day 8/04. I’ll also loop in our compliance lead (cc'd Mark) after I confirm internal timelines.

Can you include an option in the estimate that shows a 2-week pilot as a standalone fixed price and another line that shows the pilot credited toward a 12-month Dedicated commitment? That will make procurement happy.

Appreciate the speed — looking forward to the estimate on Friday.

Best,
Marta

Thanks — I sketched a practical runbook and attached a preliminary estimate (private_deploy_estimate.pdf). High-level summary below so we can finalize before I send to the customer: 

Runbook (2-week pilot):
- Day 0–1: Networking & access (VPC peering + IAM roles)
- Day 2–3: Deploy Private control plane + 2-node GPU pool (A100 equiv)
- Day 4–7: Warmup + ingest redacted sample data; run latency baseline tests (p50/p95)
- Day 8–12: Full throughput window testing (reconciliation batch) + observe KV cache behavior for prefix reuse
- Day 13–14: Regression tests + handoff notes + success scoreboard (latency targets, throughput, cost per token sample)

Estimate options included in attachment:
- Option A: Fixed-price 2-week pilot (standalone) — $34,500 (includes infra, on-site support day 2, 3 remote eng days)
- Option B: Pilot credited toward 12-month Dedicated commit — pilot cost credited up to $28,000 against the first year commit

Compliance pack: Vivek — I added a 1-page summary in the drive folder and flagged the KMS/HSM FAQ. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSTRATO-pilot
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/STR-2027-048
